boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase activities at Furman and in Greenville, with access conditions noted.

cards.title: Music by the Lake
cards.subtitle: Furman Amphitheater, Furman University
cards.notes: Check the summer-series listing, bring a seat or blanket, and listen from the Furman Amphitheater grounds beside the lake.
cards.short_summary: A free public summer concert series on Furman’s lakeside amphitheater grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Furman states that all Music by the Lake concerts are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Music by the Lake | Furman University
cards.access_notes: Concerts are free and open to the public; confirm the current concert schedule before going.

cards.title: Walk the GCMA galleries
cards.subtitle: 420 College St, Greenville
cards.notes: Visit during public hours, move through the current galleries at your own pace, and follow the museum’s gallery guidelines.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to a downtown art museum with rotating and collection galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenville County Museum of Art states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | Greenville County Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; check closures before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower
cards.title: See the view from Honor Tower
cards.subtitle: Unity Park, Greenville
cards.notes: Plan a short observation-deck visit during listed hours; children under 12 need an accompanying adult, and bags are not allowed.
cards.short_summary: A timed, accessible observation-tower visit in Unity Park.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitGreenvilleSC states that admission to the Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower is free.
cards.source_title: Thomas and Vivian A. Wong Honor Tower at Unity Park
cards.access_notes: Visits are limited to 30 minutes; listed hours are Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 1–5 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The Galleries at First Presbyterian Church
cards.title: Browse the church galleries
cards.subtitle: 200 W Washington St, Greenville
cards.notes: Use scheduled gallery hours to view rotating work across three levels, including the Lenz Gallery on the third floor.
cards.short_summary: Free public art viewing in a downtown church’s three-level gallery spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitGreenvilleSC states that admission is free and open to the public during scheduled hours.
cards.source_title: The Galleries at First Presbyterian Church
cards.access_notes: Listed gallery hours are Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Settle in with library Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: Heritage Green, downtown Greenville
cards.notes: Bring a device, connect to the library’s wireless network, and use the main branch’s indoor spaces or front lawn coverage.
cards.short_summary: Free Wi-Fi at Greenville County’s main library, including its Heritage Green lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all library locations, including the lawn in front of Hughes Main Library.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Wi-Fi hours are listed as Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m., Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sun 1–6 p.m. at Main.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi at Berea Branch
cards.subtitle: Berea, Greenville County
cards.notes: Meet with classmates or read independently using your own device, then connect to gclswireless and accept the network terms.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood library stop with systemwide free wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Connect at Five Forks Branch
cards.subtitle: Five Forks, Greenville County
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or phone, connect to the library wireless network, and choose a quiet table for a no-purchase study or catch-up session.
cards.short_summary: Free system Wi-Fi at a Greenville County Library branch.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m., Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sun 1–6 p.m. at Main and Five Forks.

cards.title: Make a free library stop
cards.subtitle: Pelham Road, Greenville
cards.notes: Bring a device and connect to gclswireless for a low-key work session; no purchase is required to use the wireless network.
cards.short_summary: A Pelham Road library hang centered on free wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Log on at Taylors Branch
cards.subtitle: Taylors, Greenville County
cards.notes: Use the library’s wireless connection for reading, planning, or a shared work session, and keep the visit within branch operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A Taylors branch visit with free county-library Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi at Greer Branch
cards.subtitle: Greer, Greenville County
cards.notes: Bring your own device, join the library wireless network, and use the branch as a no-purchase place to read or work together.
cards.short_summary: Free wireless access at the Greer branch of the county library system.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenville County Library System states that Wi-Fi is available at all Library System locations.
cards.source_title: WiFi & Public Computers | Greenville County Library System
cards.access_notes: Use the branch during its operating hours; the system lists Wi-Fi access Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–9 p.m. and Fri–Sat 8 a.m.–6 p.m.
